name: Lifecycle
headline: Replenishment flow missing — 12 consumable SKUs, 42-day cycle

headings.brandChips: Brand rules · applied to every message

targets.label: Unsubscribe rate
targets.gap: headroom for one more weekly touch

governance.label: Frequency cap
governance.detail: Four marketing emails and two SMS per person per week, counted across every journey and campaign together.

governance.label: Quiet hours
governance.detail: No sends 9pm–8am in the recipient’s local time. Nothing before 10am on Sundays.

governance.label: Journey collision
governance.detail: One lifecycle journey at a time per person. Transactional and shipping messages sit outside the cap.

governance.label: Holdout floor
governance.detail: 10% holdout on every flow, 5% where monthly reach is under 2,000. A flow without one cannot report revenue.

brandChips.label: Tone: warm, plain-spoken, no urgency countdowns
No fake scarcity or manufactured deadlines
Product photography only, no lifestyle stock

locked.label: Channel-level marketing consent
locked.detail: Email and SMS consent are tracked separately. Neither is inferred from a purchase.

locked.label: Express opt-in for SMS
locked.detail: No SMS journey can enrol a profile without a recorded express opt-in and its timestamp.

locked.label: Unsubscribe honoured in 4 hours
locked.detail: Propagates across every brand and channel in the workspace. No journey can re-enrol a profile after it.

locked.label: No re-permission campaigns
locked.detail: Unsubscribed and suppressed profiles are out of reach for every flow, including win-back.

trigger.what: Keeper flagged 12 consumable SKUs whose repurchase window closes with no lifecycle touch inside it.
Segment Value Model put the untouched cohort at 4,180 profiles and a 42-day median repurchase cycle.
Promoter sized the missing flow at $6.1K a month incremental and pinned it to the queue for a decision.

agents.name: Promoter
agents.role: Owns journey design, offer logic and the send calendar.

agents.name: Keeper
agents.role: Owns retention, suppression health and consent state.

agents.name: Segment Value Model (pLTV)
agents.role: Scores every profile on 12-month predicted value.

agents.name: Incrementality Engine
agents.role: Designs and reads the holdout behind every claim.
